name: dp/contact-form
title: Contact form
description: The form, the thank-you and the failure, as one panel. Posts to the page it is on; there is no endpoint.

messagePlaceholder.default: A project, a question, a recommendation for a good roaster.

note.default: Goes straight to my inbox. No list, no autoreply.

sentLine.default: I read everything and reply to almost everything, usually within a couple of days.

failedLine.default: Something on my end dropped it, and I would rather tell you than pretend otherwise. Your message is still in the form — try again, or email me directly and skip this thing entirely.

rateLimitedLine.default: That is a few in a short space of time, so this one was held back rather than sent. Give it ten minutes and try again — or email me directly and skip this thing entirely.
